resources.string: AI and voice commands
Navigation and reading controls
Commands, menus and macros
Gestures and typing
Speech and sound
AI agent follow-ups (SandFly Pro)

Start or stop AI agent task records the task by voice and starts the task when you stop speaking. When the agent asks a question, SandFly speaks it and records your answer. After the agent replies, use the command again within 10 minutes to give a follow-up task. To type a task instead, use Type AI agent task in Settings, Commands, Image and screen descriptions.
Usage limit (SandFly Pro)

Settings, SandFly Pro shows how much of the monthly usage limit is used. After an agent task, SandFly says the percentage once a month when 80 percent or more is used. SandFly Pro is available at three levels: SandFly Pro, SandFly Pro (2x) and SandFly Pro (4x), with 2 or 4 times the monthly usage limit.
Voice commands

You can chain voice commands with \"then\" or \"and\", run any command by its name, call a contact or number, send a message by SMS or WhatsApp, open an app, tap an item and type text. SandFly reads a message back and sends it after you say yes. To add your own phrases, go to Settings, Voice commands, Custom voice commands. Voice command phrases are in English.
AI services

Qwen, Zhipu GLM, Baichuan, DeepSeek, Kimi, Hunyuan and SiliconFlow are available in Settings, AI services, AI service. The AI service settings and On-device AI are now in Settings, AI services. Whisper and on-device AI models can download from hf-mirror.com: go to Settings, AI services, Model download server.
Scroll ahead to the next item

When the last item of a list on screen is focused, SandFly scrolls the list forward while it speaks the item, so that the next swipe moves at once. With Speak the next item while scrolling, SandFly speaks the next item as soon as it appears. Both are on by default, in Settings, Navigation.
Reading control values
Selecting a reading control says its current value after its name, such as \"Speech rate, 60 percent\".
Clipboard history reading control

In an edit box, swipe up or down to go through the clipboard history, and double-tap to paste the text that SandFly spoke. To add it, go to Settings, Reading controls, Actions for current item, Clipboard history.
Custom reading controls
A reading control made of commands. Swipe up or down to choose a command, and double-tap to run it. Go to Settings, Reading controls, Custom reading controls, and choose Add reading control.
Volume and audio output reading controls
Media volume, Call volume, Ring volume, Notification volume, Alarm volume and Audio output device are reading controls. Swipe up or down to change them. To add them, go to Settings, Reading controls.
Macros

A macro runs a series of steps as one command: run commands, wait, tap, focus or speak items, open apps and type text, with conditions such as If, Repeat and Wait until. Go to Settings, Macros, and choose Add macro. Each macro is a command in Settings, Commands, Macros.
SandFly menu and custom menus

The SandFly menu is made of commands. Go to Settings, SandFly menu, and choose Add command or Add submenu. To make other menus, go to Settings, Custom menus, and choose Add menu. Each custom menu is a command in Settings, Commands, Custom menus.
Settings profiles

A profile holds the settings you change in it, and applies them in the apps you choose, in web content, during continuous reading or while editing text. Go to Settings, Settings profiles, and choose New settings profile.
Export to file and Import from file

Macros, gesture profiles, gestures in apps, keymaps, settings profiles, dictionaries and custom voice commands can be saved to a file and read from a file. The actions are on the screen of each list and each item.
Speech history
Lists the last 100 texts that SandFly spoke, to read or copy them. The texts are kept only in memory. The command is in Settings, Commands, Reading.
Copy text from screen
Lists the text on the screen by characters, words, paragraphs, or addresses and numbers, to check and copy. The command is in Settings, Commands, Text editing.
New commands

Move to item below and Move to item above, Switch keyboard, Older app and Newer app, Answer call, Time announcements on or off, Turn direct touch on or off for this app, and a command for each Live recognition mode. Assign them in Settings, Commands.
Corner gestures
Tap, double-tap, triple-tap, double-tap and hold, or triple-tap and hold a corner of the screen to run a command. Go to Settings, Gestures, Corners. Corner gestures need Android 13 or later.
Recognize swipes before lifting
A one-finger swipe runs after the finger moves 1 cm, before it lifts. While it is on, back-and-forth and angle gestures are turned off. Go to Settings, Gestures, Recognize swipes before lifting.
Gesture start time
Sets how long a one-finger swipe may take to move 1 cm before it becomes explore by touch. Go to Settings, Gestures, Gesture start time.
Speak command at each click
When you slide in from an edge, SandFly says the command that lifting at each click runs. Go to Settings, Gestures, Edges, Speak command at each click.
Double-tap moves cursor to start or end
Double-tap the text field you are typing in to move the cursor to the start, or to the end when it is already at the start. Go to Settings, Typing, Double-tap moves cursor to start or end.
Edit and export the clipboard history
In Clipboard history, choose Edit in the actions of a text to change the text. To save the whole history as a text file, choose Export to file.
Capitalize sentences
The braille keyboard capitalizes the first letter of a sentence. Go to Settings, Braille, Braille keyboard, Capitalize sentences.
Voices by language
SandFly detects the language of text from its writing, and speaks each language with the voice you choose. Go to Settings, Speech, Voices by language, and choose Add language.
Emoji voice and Emoji speech rate

Emoji can use another voice profile and speech rate. Go to Settings, Speech, Emoji voice, and Settings, Speech, Emoji speech rate. To hear \"emoji\" after emoji names, go to Settings, Verbosity, Text and symbols.
Read line breaks as spaces
SandFly speaks each run of line breaks as one space, so that speech does not pause at them. Go to Settings, Speech, Read line breaks as spaces.
Equalizer presets
To save the equalizer bands under a name, go to Settings, Speech, Equalizer, and choose Save as preset.
Volume key settings
Silence tone during media playback, Silence speech during media playback, and Interrupt speech to announce the volume are in Settings, Volume keys.
Number of notifications
When the screen turns on, SandFly says the number of notifications after the time. Go to Settings, Verbosity, Screen on and off, When the screen turns on.
